title: Malapandaram language - Wikipedia
text: Malapandaram (IPA: [mɐlɐpːɐɳɖaːrɐm]) is a Dravidian language of Kerala and Tamil Nadu that is closely related to Tamil. [2] This is the language of the Malappandaram tribe, who live in the forest areas of Tamil Nadu and Kerala.

title: Malappandaram tribe - Wikipedia
text: The Malapandaram, also known as Mala Pandaram or Malai Pandaram, are an indigenous tribal community primarily inhabiting the eastern hilly regions of Kollam and Pathanamthitta districts in Kerala.
